name: Michigan
about: Michigan's Charitable Gaming Division lists licensed weekly bingo games with the day and hours.
hours_note: Hours come from Michigan's weekly bingo license list. Call ahead to ask when the first game starts.
list_label: Michigan Charitable Gaming Division: Find a Weekly Bingo
regulator_note: Michigan bingo is licensed by the Michigan Lottery's Charitable Gaming Division, 517-335-5780.

name: Indiana
about: The Indiana Gaming Commission lists groups with a current license that allows bingo. Its list does not show game days or times.
license_note: Indiana's license list shows this group can hold bingo, but not when. Call or look them up before you go.
list_label: Indiana Gaming Commission: Qualified Organizations with Current Licenses
regulator_note: Indiana bingo is licensed by the Indiana Gaming Commission's Charity Gaming Division, 317-232-4646.

sources.scope: Current charity gaming licenses, included as of November 13, 2026: annual licenses whose allowed activities include bingo
Indiana Gaming Commission Charity Gaming Division; phone 317-232-4646

name: Ohio
